title: webera subsessilis
intro: Webera subsessilis, commonly known as the Blue Webera or Blue Fan Flower, is a flowering plant species native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to provide relief from fever, headaches, and other health issues. The health benefits of Webera subsessilis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-pyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
